user_input: Abstract:A blockchain-based framework for distributed agile software Testing
model_output: This paper introduces a blockchain-based framework for distributed agile software testing. The proposed framework leverages the decentralized and immutable nature of blockchain technology to improve the efficiency, transparency, and trust in the software testing process. The key components of the framework include smart contracts for automating test cases, multi-party computation for secure data sharing and verification, and consensus algorithms for reaching a consensus on test results. The framework also supports the agile methodology by enabling continuous testing and feedback, as well as enabling collaboration between different teams working on the same software project. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a case study and the results show that it can significantly reduce the testing time and improve the overall quality of software.
